answer: A workable design: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the ivory to sunk effort, uses the nectar as an corroborating signal, then requires a signal before any payout.
